'''Ed Herrera''' (also published as '''Ed Herrara''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Lompoc tournament]] on 14 July 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down (dueling, IAO)]], according to Cat Ceder's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2625">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-lompoc-or-bust-7-14-01d2625/ lompoc-or-bust-7-14-01], DeckTech (Cat "CatLoneRogue" Ceder, 14 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-lompoc-or-bust-7-14-01d2625/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
